parts.text: My main daily task at the airspace desk is keeping the shared picture of the airspace, which includes the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. Regarding airspace information and flight rules, the service must handle the airspace information and flight authorisation specified by the EU U-space rules (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664) and geographical zones and operator responsibilities from the EU drone operation rules (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947).
